bio.text: Ron Estes was sworn into office in 2017 and represents Kansas's 4th District in the U.S. House; he serves on the Ways and Means and Budget committees.
Before Congress he was Sedgwick County Treasurer and then Kansas State Treasurer, after a career in consulting and management roles in aerospace, energy and manufacturing.
He grew up on a family farm in Kansas, holds a degree in civil engineering and a graduate degree in business administration, and lives in Wichita.
